$comment: train has one version, its own tags (v<version> for the core, <train>-v<version> for any other) and its own
breaking rule (minor while the train is 0.x, major from its 1.0). A train names its projects by project name, the
two the main package carries inside it included; exactly one train takes every other project (projects: *).
MSBuild reads this file through src/Directory.Build.props, by a regular expression that holds whatever the order
of the keys, and .github/scripts/release-trains.mjs reads it as JSON: release-trains.mjs check refuses any shape
the expression could misread (a nested object, a name in two trains, a brace in a string).
